the identification, quantification and isolation of fine chemicals in the biooilderived from wheat straw.
the determination of the fine chemicals in wheat straw and the aqueous and oil fractions of the fast pyrolytic biooils derived therefrom.

the chemical constituents of wheat straw can be extracted, and that these chemicals have high commercial values.
wheat straw is a valuable resource for the production of fine chemicals.

the wheat straw can be converted to high-value products such as fine chemicals, which are used as intermediates in the synthesis of pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals and other fine chemicals.
